jcr:content.jcr:description: Slow down for a wildlife walk between Portishead and Royal Portbury Dock.

placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Portbury Wharf provides a nature-focused outing close to the town. Take the reserve map with you and stay on the visitor paths while looking across the wetland landscape.

Our family idea: bring binoculars if you have them and give everyone a turn to watch quietly. Counting different bird shapes is a good starting game even when you do not know their names.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who enjoy birdwatching and quiet nature walks.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Reserve paths and wildlife-viewing opportunities; bring your own refreshments.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use the council reserve map to find the small parking area and pedestrian entrances.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Keep to designated paths, leave wildlife undisturbed and expect muddy sections after rain. Take care around water and drainage channels.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Portbury Wharf Nature Reserve, Portbury Wharf, Portishead, BS20 7TD
placevisitmap.travelNote: Use the council reserve map to find the small parking area and pedestrian entrances. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
